metadata.description: Fiction-writing plugins for Claude from the Convert Sprint Writing Studio.

plugins.name: fiction-studio
plugins.description: Writing Studio connector, drafting and planning skills, and three editor agents.

plugins.name: craft-fresh-prose
plugins.description: Fresh prose: Catches the stock phrases and habits that make prose sound machine-written.

plugins.name: craft-line-craft
plugins.description: Line craft: Sentence-level discipline: dialogue tags, verbs, rhythm and punctuation.

plugins.name: craft-scene-engine
plugins.description: Scene engine: Every scene wants something, meets resistance, and changes someone.

plugins.name: craft-pacing
plugins.description: Pacing & structure: Tension across the book: no long flat stretches, no endless peaks, a middle that pulls.

plugins.name: craft-setups-payoffs
plugins.description: Setups & payoffs: Tracks the promises your book makes to readers, and whether it keeps them.

plugins.name: craft-continuity
plugins.description: Continuity detective: Contradictions in character, timeline, world rules and facts, with evidence.

plugins.name: craft-dialogue-coach
plugins.description: Dialogue coach: Each character sounds like themselves and only knows what they should.

plugins.name: craft-market-reader
plugins.description: Market reader: A commercial reader's view beside the critic's craft view.

plugins.name: craft-mystery-fair-play
plugins.description: Mystery fair play: Every clue on the page before the reveal, and red herrings that play fair.

plugins.name: craft-romance-beats
plugins.description: Romance beats: The relationship arc readers came for, with both leads changing along the way.

plugins.name: craft-thriller-tension
plugins.description: Thriller tension: A clock that keeps ticking and stakes that rise every chapter.

plugins.name: craft-worldbuilding
plugins.description: Worldbuilding: Magic and technology with costs and limits, shown through the story, never dumped.

plugins.name: craft-serial-hooks
plugins.description: Serial hooks: Every chapter opens fast and ends with a reason to read the next one.

plugins.name: craft-blurb-pitch
plugins.description: Blurb & pitch: Back-cover copy, a one-line hook and a pitch, in the genre's own style.

plugins.name: craft-reader-emails
plugins.description: Reader emails: New-chapter, launch and update emails in your own voice, honest about what's free.

plugins.name: craft-author-bio
plugins.description: Author bio & page: An author bio and author-page copy that sound like the pen name.

plugins.name: craft-store-listing
plugins.description: Store listing: Description, keywords and categories for online bookstores, aimed at the right readers.
